name: @hoangnguyenvu12/pi-vision-bridge
description: Give non-vision pi models the ability to understand images AND video: images are described in-context before the request (plus a describe_image tool with task modes and region zoom, and a compare_images diff tool), videos are watched via ffmpeg frame samp
